name: uncommon-sales-skills
description: Uncommon Sales Skills — 10 Claude skills that run enterprise sales plays the way top reps actually sell: in the buyer's own language, sourced from your live deal data, ending in a forwardable asset.

plugins.name: account-planning
plugins.description: Build a point of view and a strategic account plan for a target account, or find and rank expansion opportunities inside an existing one.

plugins.name: call-prep
plugins.description: Prep for an upcoming sales call, discovery call, or demo so you walk in with a point of view, not a list of questions.

plugins.name: call-follow-up
plugins.description: Turn a call or group demo into the follow-up that actually moves the deal.

plugins.name: champion-enablement
plugins.description: Build the internal-selling kit your champion needs for the meetings you will not be in.

plugins.name: competitive-displacement
plugins.description: Build the narrative and the plan to unseat an incumbent or beat a competitor in a live deal.

plugins.name: deal-advancement
plugins.description: Diagnose why a deal is stuck and get it moving, or build a mutual action plan to drive it to close.

plugins.name: manage-up
plugins.description: Prep an AE to manage up to sales leadership: forecast calls, pipeline reviews, 1:1s, and deal reviews that surface territory and quarter risk clearly and ask leadership for the backing to act on it.

plugins.name: multithread
plugins.description: Map the real buying committee on an account or deal and get multithreaded across it.

plugins.name: qbr-prep
plugins.description: Prep a quarterly business review with a customer: surface the value delivered, the risks, and the expansion openings, then build the agenda.

plugins.name: one-page-business-case
plugins.description: Build a customer-specific 1-Page Business Case for a live sales deal.
